title: MEDMS Data Systems Support
before:
Current System Issues

Connect

No issues at this time.

NEO

ASD and Assessment Rosters are missing students from one or both due to issues both on the Connect and NEO side. Until the pending fix is deployed some students will drop off assessment rostering, it is expected to happen until the issue is resolved. -Expected resolution: In Progress. If you see missing students please call or email MEDMS.

MEIS

No issues at this time.

Announcements

Notice: NEO Assessment Roster Discrepancies

This school year, the Maine Department of Education is implementing a new data system called Connect. At this time, we are aware of discrepancies between students enrolled in Connect and the NEO assessment rosters.

The Maine Education Data Management System (MEDMS) Team and the Assessment Team are in close contact and are actively working together to understand and resolve this issue. We will provide additional information as it becomes available. If you have any issue please call or email MEDMS.

Data Systems

Data Systems Logins

Data Systems Access

The access request form is used to grant or update access to our five data systems (linked above). To be granted access, the requestor must ensure their district has entered them into NEO Staff.

Data Systems Training

Data systems training can be initiated for new employees or anyone who would like a refresher on our systems. This training is one-on-one with our Education Data Quality Trainer, AlLee Cookson.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 13 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 13 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.

decisions.label: Add a contents list (5 sections)
decisions.why: Built from the section headings already on the page. Below three sections a list is not a route.
